body: F5 spawns EMILY/scripts/rsi-loop.sh with MAX_ITERS=1 SKIP_WAIT=1 in goroutine, streams output to RSI ACTIVITY LOG panel. RSI LOOP section shows [F5] hint when not running. ACTIONS panel updated. Header comment documents all F1-F5 hotkeys. emily.cli commit 8c49b66.
title: emily tui: F5 = fire RSI loop iteration in background
